Class SpringAsmInfo

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.asm.SpringAsmInfo
public final class SpringAsmInfo extends Object
Utility class exposing constants related to Spring's internal repackaging of the ASM bytecode library: currently based on ASM 9.x plus minor patches.

有关 `org.springframework.asm` 的更多信息，请参阅包级 Javadoc。
